chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father, both together from Ibn Mahboub from Khaleel ibn Amr al-Yashkuri from Jameel ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) used to say: When the boy is one with cloudy testicular fluid, small of the penis, and relaxed in gaze, he is one from whom goodness is hoped and his evil is secured.
And when the boy is one with hard testicular fluid, large of the penis, and sharp in gaze, he is one from whom goodness is not hoped and his evil is secured.
ai.seo_question: What physical and behavioral signs in a boy indicate his future character according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elaborates on the physical and behavioral indicators of a boy's innate disposition (fitrah), linking modesty and calmness to spiritual promise, while sharpness and intensity signal potential for mischief. It reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of observing external signs (alamarat) as clues to internal character, emphasizing that early behavioral traits often foreshadow adult moral trajectories. The contrast highlights the value of restraint and humility in youth as precursors to righteousness.
